title: Add skills_extracted field to live_status.json
description: Dashboard reads d.skills_extracted at line 614 of voyage.html but _write_live_status() never writes the field. Always shows '--'. Fix: preserve skills_extracted from existing live_status.json during writes, add _update_skills_count() function, call it from loop.py after condense_round().
definition-of-done: 1. _write_live_status() preserves skills_extracted from existing JSON. 2. _update_skills_count(reference_obj, count) increments the field. 3. loop.py calls _update_skills_count after condense_round. 4. Dashboard shows actual skill count instead of '--'.
testing-plan: 1. Run a voyage round with condenser extracting skills. 2. Check live_status.json contains skills_extracted field with correct count. 3. Dashboard shows the number.
